profile.summary: Urban Heat Academy describes itself as an after-school and enrichment organization for students in grades K-12. It says it works to prepare youth for college through tutoring, arts and step programs, and health and fitness activities. It says it has school sites in Vallejo, Stockton and Oakland, California.
